summary: Use 'fewer' with countable plural nouns, with time, money, distance and weight as common exceptions treated as amounts.
questions: When do I use 'fewer' instead of 'less'?

answer_card.title: Fewer
answer_card.answer_md: Use **fewer** with things you can count (fewer tasks). Time, money, distance and weight are usually treated as amounts: "less than 5 hours".
